prompt: Write an ADR for today's decision: we cache the product catalog in Redis instead of PostgreSQL materialized views.
check: [ $(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 1 ] && f=$(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md) && grep -qiE "^#+ *status|^status:|\*\*status" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*context" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*decision" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*consequences" "$f" && grep -qi redis "$f" && grep -qiE "materiali[sz]ed|postgres" "$f" && grep -qiE "negative|downside|drawback|\bcons\b|trade-?off|cost|risk|overhead|dependency|stale|complexity" "$f" && [ $(wc -w < "$f") -le 1200 ] && grep -q "0004" docs/decisions/README.md && cmp -s docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md .git/eval/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md && cmp -s docs/decisions/0002-use-mongodb-for-user-profiles.md .git/eval/0002-use-mongodb-for-user-profiles.md && cmp -s docs/decisions/0003-rest-for-public-api.md .git/eval/0003-rest-for-public-api.md

check: [ $(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 1 ] && f=$(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md) && grep -qi graphql "$f" && grep -q "0003" "$f" && sh /tmp/skill-diet-work/adr/fixtures/same-body.sh docs/decisions/0003-rest-for-public-api.md && grep -qiE "supersed|deprecat" docs/decisions/0003-rest-for-public-api.md

prompt: Do we need an ADR for bumping lodash from 4.17.20 to 4.17.21 to pick up a security patch? Answer briefly.
We spent two weeks evaluating a move from Heroku to Kubernetes and decided not to do it: too much ops work for a 3-person team. Record that.
check: [ $(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 1 ] && f=$(ls docs/decisions/0004-*.md) && grep -qiE "^#+ *status|^status:|\*\*status" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*context" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*decision" "$f" && grep -qiE "^#+ .*consequences" "$f" && grep -qi kubernetes "$f" && grep -qi heroku "$f" && grep -qiE "ops|operat" "$f" && grep -q "0004" docs/decisions/README.md

prompt: Give me a Y-statement ADR for choosing Kong as our API gateway over AWS API Gateway; we accept running Kong ourselves. Print it only, write no files.
Use adr-tools to record that we are replacing the cron background jobs with a Celery worker queue. It supersedes ADR 2. Fill in the content too.
check: grep -qE "new .*-s +2|new -s2" .git/adr-calls.log && f=$(ls doc/architecture/decisions/0003-*.md) && grep -qi celery "$f" && ! grep -q "The issue motivating this decision" "$f" && grep -qiE "supersed|superced" doc/architecture/decisions/0002-*.md

prompt: The ADR index in docs/decisions/README.md is out of date. Fix it.
check: r=docs/decisions/README.md; for n in 0001 0002 0003 0004 0005 0006; do grep -q "$n-" $r || exit 1; done; grep "0002-" $r | grep -qiE "supersed|deprecat" && grep "0005-" $r | grep -qi proposed && grep "0006-" $r | grep -qi accepted && grep "0004-" $r | grep -qi accepted
